segments.zh: 先把一束玫瑰看成有分量的色块，再逐步建立光色和形体。今天用十分钟认识新工作台，也练习从剪影到花瓣的过程。
segments.en: First read a bouquet as bold masses, then build its light, color, and volume. In ten minutes, explore the new workspace and work from silhouettes toward petals.

pairs.zh: 先把一束玫瑰看成有分量的色块，再逐步建立光色和形体。
pairs.en: First read a bouquet as bold masses, then build its light, color, and volume.

pairs.zh: 今天用十分钟认识新工作台，也练习从剪影到花瓣的过程。
pairs.en: In ten minutes, explore the new workspace and work from silhouettes toward petals.

segments.shot: 新图标进入浅色工作台。短暂展示生成花束参考并标注来源。

segments.zh: 这里是新的绘画与图像编辑工作台，从简单形状开始一段练习。花束是生成的观察参考，接下来的笔触演示来自真实绘画引擎。
segments.en: This is the updated painting workspace. Begin a study with simple shapes. The bouquet is a generated reference; the stroke demonstrations use the real painting engine.

pairs.zh: 这里是新的绘画与图像编辑工作台，从简单形状开始一段练习。
pairs.en: This is the updated painting workspace. Begin a study with simple shapes.

pairs.zh: 花束是生成的观察参考，接下来的笔触演示来自真实绘画引擎。
pairs.en: The bouquet is a generated reference; the stroke demonstrations use the real painting engine.

segments.shot: 首页进入画布。参考图独立展示并标注 Generated study reference。

segments.zh: 这一片只展示浅色英文界面，让画布和正在进行的笔触留在中心。侧栏平时保持收起，需要完整设置时再打开。
segments.en: This film uses the light English interface, keeping the canvas and active marks central. Keep the sidebar tucked away until you need its full controls.

pairs.zh: 这一片只展示浅色英文界面，让画布和正在进行的笔触留在中心。
pairs.en: This film uses the light English interface, keeping the canvas and active marks central.

pairs.zh: 侧栏平时保持收起，需要完整设置时再打开。
pairs.en: Keep the sidebar tucked away until you need its full controls.

segments.shot: 浅色英文UI全景。打开并关闭侧面板。

segments.zh: 工具栏可以放在四边，常用工具的顺序也能按习惯重新安排。把动作放到顺手的位置，画画时就少一些来回寻找。
segments.en: Dock the toolbar on any edge and reorder familiar tools to suit your habits. Put actions within reach so painting takes less searching.

pairs.zh: 工具栏可以放在四边，常用工具的顺序也能按习惯重新安排。
pairs.en: Dock the toolbar on any edge and reorder familiar tools to suit your habits.

pairs.zh: 把动作放到顺手的位置，画画时就少一些来回寻找。
pairs.en: Put actions within reach so painting takes less searching.

segments.shot: 工具栏位置控制和工具菜单。只用真实截图。

segments.zh: 换一个工具，画布下方的胶囊就换成它此刻最需要的快捷参数。大小和透明度就近调整，完整侧栏仍然保留。
segments.en: Switch tools and the capsule shows the quick controls that matter at that moment. Adjust size and opacity nearby while the full sidebar remains available.

pairs.zh: 换一个工具，画布下方的胶囊就换成它此刻最需要的快捷参数。
pairs.en: Switch tools and the capsule shows the quick controls that matter at that moment.

pairs.zh: 大小和透明度就近调整，完整侧栏仍然保留。
pairs.en: Adjust size and opacity nearby while the full sidebar remains available.

segments.shot: 实际Brush上下文胶囊。打开大小/透明度popup。

segments.zh: 鼠标现在是一支系统笔形指针，笔尖就是画布上准确的落笔位置。缩放和旋转只是改变观看方式，不会改动作品像素。
segments.en: The system mouse pointer is now a pen, whose tip marks the drawing position. Zoom and rotation change the view without changing the artwork's pixels.

pairs.zh: 鼠标现在是一支系统笔形指针，笔尖就是画布上准确的落笔位置。
pairs.en: The system mouse pointer is now a pen, whose tip marks the drawing position.

pairs.zh: 缩放和旋转只是改变观看方式，不会改动作品像素。
pairs.en: Zoom and rotation change the view without changing the artwork's pixels.

segments.shot: 真实笔形系统cursor capture。画布缩放/旋转和背景切换。

segments.zh: 启动按偏好直接进入作品首页，或者进入准备好的空白绘画画布。这里能查找和排序作品，深色主题同样可以在设置中选择。
segments.en: Start directly in the project library or on a blank canvas, following your preference. Find and sort projects here. A dark theme is also available in settings.

pairs.zh: 启动按偏好直接进入作品首页，或者进入准备好的空白绘画画布。
pairs.en: Start directly in the project library or on a blank canvas, following your preference.

pairs.zh: 这里能查找和排序作品，深色主题同样可以在设置中选择。
pairs.en: Find and sort projects here. A dark theme is also available in settings.

segments.shot: 首页搜索和回到画布。字幕文字说明Dark optional不展示Dark。

segments.zh: 内置笔刷现在有二十四个预设，初次绘画仍从默认墨水笔开始。先试几种笔触，再把常用预设收藏起来。
segments.en: There are twenty-four built-in presets; a first painting still starts with Ink. Test a few strokes, then favorite the presets you reach for.

pairs.zh: 内置笔刷现在有二十四个预设，初次绘画仍从默认墨水笔开始。
pairs.en: There are twenty-four built-in presets; a first painting still starts with Ink.

pairs.zh: 先试几种笔触，再把常用预设收藏起来。
pairs.en: Test a few strokes, then favorite the presets you reach for.

segments.shot: 笔刷库滚动展示24项。搜索及favorite。

segments.zh: 中文柳叶笔是英文圈选填色工具，用闭合形状建立清楚的色块。画一圈闭合轮廓，松手填色，适合花瓣和整块剪影。
segments.en: The Chinese Liuye tool is Lasso fill in English, building color masses from closed shapes. Draw a closed outline and release to fill it—ideal for petals and silhouettes.

pairs.zh: 中文柳叶笔是英文圈选填色工具，用闭合形状建立清楚的色块。
pairs.en: The Chinese Liuye tool is Lasso fill in English, building color masses from closed shapes.

pairs.zh: 画一圈闭合轮廓，松手填色，适合花瓣和整块剪影。
pairs.en: Draw a closed outline and release to fill it—ideal for petals and silhouettes.

segments.shot: Lasso fill闭合一片花瓣并松手填色。

segments.zh: 叶形笔尖跟随整段笔画的方向，转弯时宽窄和姿态也一起改变。它叫柳条笔，适合收锋和拉出叶片，别与圈选填色混淆。
segments.en: The leaf-shaped tip follows the stroke, changing its width and pose as it turns. Willow helps taper strokes and form leaves; it is separate from Lasso fill.

pairs.zh: 叶形笔尖跟随整段笔画的方向，转弯时宽窄和姿态也一起改变。
pairs.en: The leaf-shaped tip follows the stroke, changing its width and pose as it turns.

pairs.zh: 它叫柳条笔，适合收锋和拉出叶片，别与圈选填色混淆。
pairs.en: Willow helps taper strokes and form leaves; it is separate from Lasso fill.

segments.shot: Willow与Lance真实曲线笔触并放大起收锋。

segments.zh: 同一支笔改变大小和硬度，就能从局部边缘描画转向大面积铺色。再调间距和纸纹，看看笔触怎样与画布纹理相处。
segments.en: Change size and hardness to move from local edges to broad areas of color. Then adjust spacing and paper texture to see how the marks settle.

pairs.zh: 同一支笔改变大小和硬度，就能从局部边缘描画转向大面积铺色。
pairs.en: Change size and hardness to move from local edges to broad areas of color.

pairs.zh: 再调间距和纸纹，看看笔触怎样与画布纹理相处。
pairs.en: Then adjust spacing and paper texture to see how the marks settle.

segments.shot: 大小硬度间距纸纹对比色条。

segments.zh: 压感分别影响大小和透明度，响应曲线也能按你的手感重新调整。需要规则图案时打开对称，先看轴线位置再落笔。
segments.en: Pressure affects size and opacity separately, with curves adjusted to your touch. For repeating forms, enable symmetry and place the axis before painting.

pairs.zh: 压感分别影响大小和透明度，响应曲线也能按你的手感重新调整。
pairs.en: Pressure affects size and opacity separately, with curves adjusted to your touch.

pairs.zh: 需要规则图案时打开对称，先看轴线位置再落笔。
pairs.en: For repeating forms, enable symmetry and place the axis before painting.

segments.shot: 真实native笔触pressure sample。轴线对称绘画。

segments.zh: 涂抹把已有颜色沿短笔触推开，少量混色可以连接相邻的大色块。像素笔另有清晰的像素模式，自定义笔刷也能保存和导入。
segments.en: Short smudge strokes push existing color; gentle mixing joins neighboring masses. Pixel presets keep a distinct raster mode. Custom brushes can be saved and imported.

pairs.zh: 涂抹把已有颜色沿短笔触推开，少量混色可以连接相邻的大色块。
pairs.en: Short smudge strokes push existing color; gentle mixing joins neighboring masses.

pairs.zh: 像素笔另有清晰的像素模式，自定义笔刷也能保存和导入。
pairs.en: Pixel presets keep a distinct raster mode. Custom brushes can be saved and imported.

segments.shot: Smudge短推色。PixelPencil/Perfect样例。导入brushmenu。

segments.zh: 先把花束看成暗红与深绿的大块，再用色轮仔细寻找冷暖关系。把选好的颜色存进个人色卡，回到画布时少一些犹豫。
segments.en: Read the bouquet as broad dark reds and greens, then find their warm and cool shifts. Save chosen colors to a personal palette so painting stays decisive.

pairs.zh: 先把花束看成暗红与深绿的大块，再用色轮仔细寻找冷暖关系。
pairs.en: Read the bouquet as broad dark reds and greens, then find their warm and cool shifts.

pairs.zh: 把选好的颜色存进个人色卡，回到画布时少一些犹豫。
pairs.en: Save chosen colors to a personal palette so painting stays decisive.

segments.shot: 色轮slider真实panel。保存wine-redpalette swatch。

segments.zh: 取色从画布寻找已经用过的颜色，也能提取一组互相联系的主要色。色卡支持几种常见交换格式，输出前留意名称是否保留。
segments.en: Pick colors already used on the canvas, or extract a related set of dominant hues. Palettes support common exchange formats; check whether names survive export.

pairs.zh: 取色从画布寻找已经用过的颜色，也能提取一组互相联系的主要色。
pairs.en: Pick colors already used on the canvas, or extract a related set of dominant hues.

pairs.zh: 色卡支持几种常见交换格式，输出前留意名称是否保留。
pairs.en: Palettes support common exchange formats; check whether names survive export.

segments.shot: 画布pick。extractpalette以及ASE/GPL/PAL菜单。

segments.zh: 渐变从两个颜色端点开始，线性与径向能建立不同的空间方向。填充用于铺区域色，渐变反转前先看预览，再决定是否确认。
segments.en: Gradients start with two color endpoints; linear and radial shapes suggest different space. Fill lays regional color. Preview a gradient's reversal before committing.

pairs.zh: 渐变从两个颜色端点开始，线性与径向能建立不同的空间方向。
pairs.en: Gradients start with two color endpoints; linear and radial shapes suggest different space.

pairs.zh: 填充用于铺区域色，渐变反转前先看预览，再决定是否确认。
pairs.en: Fill lays regional color. Preview a gradient's reversal before committing.

segments.shot: 线性渐变拖拽。反转。径向渐变小演示。

segments.zh: 选区先把需要修改的范围说清楚，自由套索尤其适合不规则形状。矩形和椭圆更规则，魔棒则按颜色寻找相近区域。
segments.en: A selection defines the editing area; a freehand lasso suits irregular shapes. Rectangles and ellipses are regular; the wand finds areas by color.

pairs.zh: 选区先把需要修改的范围说清楚，自由套索尤其适合不规则形状。
pairs.en: A selection defines the editing area; a freehand lasso suits irregular shapes.

pairs.zh: 矩形和椭圆更规则，魔棒则按颜色寻找相近区域。
pairs.en: Rectangles and ellipses are regular; the wand finds areas by color.

segments.shot: 矩形/椭圆/Lasso/Wand以及add/subtract比对。

segments.zh: 选区可以叠加或相减，反选和边缘调整也能把修改范围整理准确。复制和剪切把局部带到新图层，让修改更容易回头。
segments.en: Add or subtract selections, invert them, and refine edges to define the edit accurately. Copy and cut move a region into a new layer, making revisions easier.

pairs.zh: 选区可以叠加或相减，反选和边缘调整也能把修改范围整理准确。
pairs.en: Add or subtract selections, invert them, and refine edges to define the edit accurately.

pairs.zh: 复制和剪切把局部带到新图层，让修改更容易回头。
pairs.en: Copy and cut move a region into a new layer, making revisions easier.

segments.shot: 选区羽化与复制粘贴成layer。

segments.zh: 像素作品可以进入索引颜色模式，把整幅作品约束在同一张色卡内。它有自己的工具限制，选择之前先想清楚作品需要什么。
segments.en: An indexed-color document keeps the whole pixel artwork within one palette. It has its own tool limits; choose it to suit the artwork.

pairs.zh: 像素作品可以进入索引颜色模式，把整幅作品约束在同一张色卡内。
pairs.en: An indexed-color document keeps the whole pixel artwork within one palette.

pairs.zh: 它有自己的工具限制，选择之前先想清楚作品需要什么。
pairs.en: It has its own tool limits; choose it to suit the artwork.

segments.shot: IndexedPalette caption和unsupported controls disabled截图。

segments.zh: 背景与花朵先放进不同图层，把名字写清楚，再逐步加入局部细节。拖动缩略图调整顺序，用图层组整理较复杂的作品。
segments.en: Separate the background and flowers into named layers, then gradually add local detail. Reorder thumbnails and use groups to organize a more complex piece.

pairs.zh: 背景与花朵先放进不同图层，把名字写清楚，再逐步加入局部细节。
pairs.en: Separate the background and flowers into named layers, then gradually add local detail.

pairs.zh: 拖动缩略图调整顺序，用图层组整理较复杂的作品。
pairs.en: Reorder thumbnails and use groups to organize a more complex piece.

segments.shot: 新layer重命名排序group。

segments.zh: 图层的不透明度和八种混合模式，都能先在原画布上预览和比较。透明度锁定适合改已有色块，内容锁定则保护整层。
segments.en: Preview and compare layer opacity and eight blending modes on the original canvas. Alpha lock recolors existing shapes; content lock protects the layer.

pairs.zh: 图层的不透明度和八种混合模式，都能先在原画布上预览和比较。
pairs.en: Preview and compare layer opacity and eight blending modes on the original canvas.

pairs.zh: 透明度锁定适合改已有色块，内容锁定则保护整层。
pairs.en: Alpha lock recolors existing shapes; content lock protects the layer.

segments.shot: Opacity/blendpreview compare，alpha lock开关。

segments.zh: 蒙版用黑白控制图层显示范围，让遮挡和恢复都保留原来的画面。剪贴图层把新颜色限制在底层，花瓣边缘就更容易保持。
segments.en: Masks control layer visibility in black and white, preserving the original artwork. Clipping confines new color to a base layer and helps preserve petal edges.

pairs.zh: 蒙版用黑白控制图层显示范围，让遮挡和恢复都保留原来的画面。
pairs.en: Masks control layer visibility in black and white, preserving the original artwork.

pairs.zh: 剪贴图层把新颜色限制在底层，花瓣边缘就更容易保持。
pairs.en: Clipping confines new color to a base layer and helps preserve petal edges.

segments.shot: white/selectionmask绘制及clippinglayer。

segments.zh: 变换先预览图层的位置和尺寸，满意以后再提交为一笔完整编辑。曲线和渐变映射也能用于调整图层，继续保留修改空间。
segments.en: Preview a layer's position and size, then commit the transform as one complete edit. Curves and gradient maps can be adjustment layers, leaving room to revise.

pairs.zh: 变换先预览图层的位置和尺寸，满意以后再提交为一笔完整编辑。
pairs.en: Preview a layer's position and size, then commit the transform as one complete edit.

pairs.zh: 曲线和渐变映射也能用于调整图层，继续保留修改空间。
pairs.en: Curves and gradient maps can be adjustment layers, leaving room to revise.

segments.shot: transformpreview，以及曲线/gradientmapadjustmentlayer。

segments.zh: 基础矢量能编辑节点，透视助手和漫画线都可预览。复杂层导出前，先检查哪些效果需要烘焙。
segments.en: Basic vectors offer node editing; perspective assistants and comic lines can be previewed. Before exporting complex layers, check which effects need baking.

pairs.zh: 基础矢量能编辑节点，透视助手和漫画线都可预览。
pairs.en: Basic vectors offer node editing; perspective assistants and comic lines can be previewed.

pairs.zh: 复杂层导出前，先检查哪些效果需要烘焙。
pairs.en: Before exporting complex layers, check which effects need baking.

segments.shot: basicvectorellipse与perspectiveguide，exportbakeUI。

segments.zh: 逐帧动画从打开时间轴开始，原画布仍然保留你熟悉的绘画方式。先加几帧简单变化，观察轮廓怎样从上一帧走到下一帧。
segments.en: Open the timeline to begin frame animation while keeping the familiar painting canvas. Add a few simple changes and watch a form move from one frame to the next.

pairs.zh: 逐帧动画从打开时间轴开始，原画布仍然保留你熟悉的绘画方式。
pairs.en: Open the timeline to begin frame animation while keeping the familiar painting canvas.

pairs.zh: 先加几帧简单变化，观察轮廓怎样从上一帧走到下一帧。
pairs.en: Add a few simple changes and watch a form move from one frame to the next.

segments.shot: 打开Animationtimeline一次初始化。

segments.zh: 先复制一帧再画变化，适合保留已经建立好的轮廓和基础色块。洋葱皮让前后位置更容易比较，但不会成为输出画面。
segments.en: Duplicate a frame before changing it to preserve the established outline and color masses. Onion skin helps compare neighboring positions without appearing in the output.

pairs.zh: 先复制一帧再画变化，适合保留已经建立好的轮廓和基础色块。
pairs.en: Duplicate a frame before changing it to preserve the established outline and color masses.

pairs.zh: 洋葱皮让前后位置更容易比较，但不会成为输出画面。
pairs.en: Onion skin helps compare neighboring positions without appearing in the output.

segments.shot: 复制帧洋葱皮真实thumbnail。

segments.zh: 时间轴的图层轨道对应画面结构，关键帧指出哪里出现新的内容。连续单元可以共享画面，拖动标尺就能查看更长的片段。
segments.en: Timeline layer tracks reflect the artwork's structure; keyframes mark new content. Held cells can share artwork; drag the ruler to browse a longer sequence.

pairs.zh: 时间轴的图层轨道对应画面结构，关键帧指出哪里出现新的内容。
pairs.en: Timeline layer tracks reflect the artwork's structure; keyframes mark new content.

pairs.zh: 连续单元可以共享画面，拖动标尺就能查看更长的片段。
pairs.en: Held cells can share artwork; drag the ruler to browse a longer sequence.

segments.shot: 标尺拖动view，轨道关键帧holdcells。

segments.zh: 每一帧的时长决定动作节奏，先在实际播放里检查轻重和停顿。范围和播放方向可以调整，小动画也值得把节奏做清楚。
segments.en: Each frame's duration shapes the rhythm; check its emphasis and pauses in actual playback. Adjust the range and direction; even a small animation benefits from clear timing.

pairs.zh: 每一帧的时长决定动作节奏，先在实际播放里检查轻重和停顿。
pairs.en: Each frame's duration shapes the rhythm; check its emphasis and pauses in actual playback.

pairs.zh: 范围和播放方向可以调整，小动画也值得把节奏做清楚。
pairs.en: Adjust the range and direction; even a small animation benefits from clear timing.

segments.shot: durationdialog forward/pingpong。

segments.zh: 完成之后导出动图或图片图集，按照展示与使用方式选择输出。动图有颜色和透明度限制，格式交换也不是所有功能都通用。
segments.en: Export a GIF or image atlas according to how the sequence will be shown and used. GIF has color and alpha limits, and interchange formats do not preserve every feature.

pairs.zh: 完成之后导出动图或图片图集，按照展示与使用方式选择输出。
pairs.en: Export a GIF or image atlas according to how the sequence will be shown and used.

pairs.zh: 动图有颜色和透明度限制，格式交换也不是所有功能都通用。
pairs.en: GIF has color and alpha limits, and interchange formats do not preserve every feature.

title_en: A rose study in broad marks

segments.zh: 这是一段基于参考取色的加速笔触练习。图像没有导入为作品，五个阶段由原生笔刷重新铺出。
segments.en: This is an accelerated brush study, with colors sampled from the reference. The reference is not imported as artwork; native brush marks build five stages.

pairs.zh: 这是一段基于参考取色的加速笔触练习。
pairs.en: This is an accelerated brush study, with colors sampled from the reference.

pairs.zh: 图像没有导入为作品，五个阶段由原生笔刷重新铺出。
pairs.en: The reference is not imported as artwork; native brush marks build five stages.

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 第一阶段用大号油画笔建立宽阔色块。先分开背景和花束，让黑色包装承托红色花团。
segments.en: Stage one lays in broad masses with a large Oils preset. Separate bouquet and background, using black wrapping to support the red blooms.

pairs.zh: 第一阶段用大号油画笔建立宽阔色块。
pairs.en: Stage one lays in broad masses with a large Oils preset.

pairs.zh: 先分开背景和花束，让黑色包装承托红色花团。
pairs.en: Separate bouquet and background, using black wrapping to support the red blooms.

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 第二阶段重新建立主要暗部和受光面。先看大面积的明暗关系，不急着描画每一片花瓣。
segments.en: Stage two establishes the main shadows and lit planes. Read the large value relationships before describing individual petals.

pairs.zh: 第二阶段重新建立主要暗部和受光面。
pairs.en: Stage two establishes the main shadows and lit planes.

pairs.zh: 先看大面积的明暗关系，不急着描画每一片花瓣。
pairs.en: Read the large value relationships before describing individual petals.

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 观察冷红与暖红的交替，让花团形成前后层次。这段取色练习展示笔触的累积，不是原速手工录像。
segments.en: Observe alternating cool and warm reds to separate the flower masses. This sampled-color study shows marks accumulating, not real-time manual footage.

pairs.zh: 观察冷红与暖红的交替，让花团形成前后层次。
pairs.en: Observe alternating cool and warm reds to separate the flower masses.

pairs.zh: 这段取色练习展示笔触的累积，不是原速手工录像。
pairs.en: This sampled-color study shows marks accumulating, not real-time manual footage.

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 第三阶段缩小笔触，逐步找回叶片和包装的转折。油画笔与干平刷留下不同边缘，帮助区分形体。
segments.en: Stage three uses smaller marks to recover turns in foliage and wrapping. Oil and Dry brush brushes leave different edges to distinguish the forms.

pairs.zh: 第三阶段缩小笔触，逐步找回叶片和包装的转折。
pairs.en: Stage three uses smaller marks to recover turns in foliage and wrapping.

pairs.zh: 油画笔与干平刷留下不同边缘，帮助区分形体。
pairs.en: Oil and Dry brush brushes leave different edges to distinguish the forms.

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 厚涂感来自色块的安排，以及有方向的笔触。这里没有模拟三维颜料，重点是明暗和边缘的控制。
segments.en: The impasto impression comes from arranged masses and directional marks. This is not a three-dimensional paint simulation; values and edges do the work.

pairs.zh: 厚涂感来自色块的安排，以及有方向的笔触。
pairs.en: The impasto impression comes from arranged masses and directional marks.

pairs.zh: 这里没有模拟三维颜料，重点是明暗和边缘的控制。

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 第四阶段继续细化花瓣，把细节留给主要花朵。暗部保持简洁，少量明确的亮面就能塑造花瓣。
segments.en: Stage four refines petals, reserving detail for the main roses. Keep shadows simple; a few clear lit planes can describe the petals.

pairs.zh: 第四阶段继续细化花瓣，把细节留给主要花朵。
pairs.en: Stage four refines petals, reserving detail for the main roses.

pairs.zh: 暗部保持简洁，少量明确的亮面就能塑造花瓣。

segments.shot: Reference-sampled accelerated native brush study: five real Oily/DryFlat stages; generated reference shown separately.

segments.zh: 先把这一阶段与前面的铺色比较，再决定细化多少。有些边缘保持模糊，画面才会留下安静的空间。
segments.en: Compare this stage with the block-in before deciding how much to resolve. Leave some edges unresolved so the painting retains quiet passages.

segments.zh: 最后阶段补充浅色小花与高光，再检查整体层次。练习画布由真实笔触组成，与生成参考分开展示。
segments.en: The last stage adds pale flowers and highlights, then checks the overall hierarchy. The study canvas consists of real brush marks and is shown separately from the reference.
